spec2def(mciavi32.dll mciavi32.spec)

# mciavi32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mciavi32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(mciavi32_shims OBJECT info.c mciavi.c mmoutput.c wnd.c)
target_link_libraries(mciavi32_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libmsvfw32 libwinmm libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32_vista libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(mciavi32_shims)
add_cargo_module(mciavi32 mciavi32-cargo mciavi32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mciavi32_shims psdk)
